finding: CG land records are open (no captcha). Property cards / abadi are NOT held as per-household records: abadi is a single government khasra per village. Of the researcher-sampled survey numbers that resolve on Bhuiyan, only 8/61 carry abadi tenure; 44 are govt land, 9 private agricultural. No abadi charge/lien field exists on the portal (CERSAI is an external link), so CG offers no on-record property-card collateral signal to census. Mutation status IS retrievable per khasra (unlike MP).
